inspection_summary: Inspected all 869 lines. The paper recasts Robin's RH criterion as a counterexample-elimination program: prove large squarefree, odd, and squarefull classes safe; characterize extremal divisor ratios on t-free and exponent-pattern classes; canonicalize any dangerous pattern to a Hardy-Ramanujan integer; then combine minimal-counterexample descent, explicit prime-product bounds, a cascading largest-prime reduction, and a finite computation to show every 5-free integer satisfies Robin's inequality.
